_about: War: a unit with a mission, under time, pressure, morale and supply. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

objective: carry a message the radio cannot
retake a village lost last week
enemy: a disciplined army with better guns
an enemy who is also starving
an unseen force that strikes at night
pressure: the clock: relief arrives in three days, maybe
morale: the last mission went badly
unit_trouble: two soldiers with a blood feud
a medic who has stopped caring
a soldier too young to be there
a hero whose nerve is going
moral_choice: a village that helped the enemy
an order to burn the fields
a wounded enemy asking for help
leaving someone behind to save the rest

1: a scout does not come back
2: the plan breaks on the ground
4: the objective is in reach, at a price
hold, break, or choose who lives

cliches: the soldier with a photo of his sweetheart dies first
